title: Code for: Time-anchored prognostic information from diagnosis-coded comorbidity and laboratory-derived deficit burden in older critically ill patients with coronary artery disease: a multicohort retrospective study
description: Clean code archive aligned to the current manuscript, including the eICU time-anchored diagnosis-availability, fixed-cohort and true 6/24/36-hour landmark analyses. No patient-level controlled-access data are included.
